Interface GameEventEmitter

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameNotifier
public interface GameEventEmitter
Internal interface through which GameBoard and Game fire game-level notifications. Implemented by GameNotifier, which forwards each call to all registered GameObservers.

This interface separates the emission API (used by model classes) from the subscription API (GameObserverRegistry), following the Interface Segregation Principle.

  • Method Details

    • emitOutcome

      void emitOutcome(EffectOutcome outcome)
      Iterates over the EffectOutcome's resource deltas and fires notifyPlayerResourceChanged(String, ResourceType, int, int) for each one. No-op if the outcome is null or empty.
      Parameters:
      outcome - the aggregated effect outcome to broadcast

    • notifyGameSetupCompleted

      void notifyGameSetupCompleted(Map<String,Totem> totemByPlayer, List<String> turnOrder, Map<String,Integer> initialFood, BoardSnapshot boardSnapshot)
      Notifies observers that game setup has completed and the first round is about to start.
      Parameters:
      totemByPlayer - mapping from nickname to assigned totem
      turnOrder - the initial randomized placement order
      initialFood - mapping from nickname to starting food points
      boardSnapshot - full snapshot of the initial board state
